name: Tumble
tagline: One die sets the trump; the leader may flip it first.
core_loop: Roll the die for the trick mode, the leader keeps or flips it, everyone plays one card with no follow-suit duty, and the winner scores 1 plus one point per trump card in the trick.
win_condition: Most points when every hand and the draw pile are empty; ties break on tricks won, then the most recent trick win, then seat order from the dealer's left.
